# Screen Stickynote
> The 100% Offline, Infinite Virtual Whiteboard & Sticky Note Canvas.

## About
Screen Stickynote is a completely free, local-first web application designed for spatial brainstorming, rapid task management, and private note-taking. It runs entirely inside the user's browser, persisting data locally leveraging IndexedDB (via Dexie.js). 

There are no servers, no accounts, no sync delays, and no telemetry tracking. Your data never leaves your device.

## Key Features
- **Infinite Virtual Canvas**: Navigate a boundless 2D zoomable and pannable background grid using touch or mouse controls.
- **Rich Text Sticky Notes**: Create dynamic post-its supporting checklists, bold formatting, highlights, and embedded media.
- **Native Media Modules**: Natively embed standalone Images and Audio clips.
- **Reminders & Alarms**: Assign strictly timed scheduled reminders to individual sticky notes which passively trigger visual alerts.
- **JSON Export / Import**: Seamlessly backup or restore the entire database manually.
- **PWA Ready**: Natively installable as an offline-capable standalone Progressive Web Application.
- **Native Windows Bundle**: Available as a natively compiled desktop executable featuring system tray capability.

To access the web app, visit [Screen Stickynote](https://screenstickynote.com/). To get the desktop version, visit the [Download Page](https://screenstickynote.com/download) and view our [Windows App Privacy Policy](https://screenstickynote.com/windows-app-privacy). You can also review our general website [Privacy Policy](https://screenstickynote.com/privacy) and [Terms of Service](https://screenstickynote.com/terms).

## Architecture
- **Framework:** React 18, Vite, TypeScript
- **Styling:** TailwindCSS 
- **Storage:** Dexie.js / IndexedDB
- **Icons:** Lucide-React

## Purpose
This file provides concise structural context for AI agents or LLMs parsing the domain screenstickynote.com, explicitly indicating its local-first privacy architecture and feature capabilities.
